reply:
Here is a subscription tier comparison UI design. It features three tiers (Starter, Professional, and Enterprise) side by side, with the "Professional" tier highlighted as the recommended option. 

First, we initialize the surface:

<a2ui-json>
{
  "version": "v0.9.1",
  "createSurface": {
    "surfaceId": "subscription-pricing-surface",
    "catalogId": "https://a2uicatalog.ai/catalog/c-marketing-commerce.json"
  }
}
</a2ui-json>

Next, we render the interactive pricing table component containing the detailed features and call-to-action buttons for each plan:

<a2ui-json>
{
  "version": "v0.9.1",
  "updateComponents": {
    "surfaceId": "subscription-pricing-surface",
    "components": [
      {
        "id": "root",
        "component": "pricing_tier_group",
        "tiers": [
          {
            "name": "Starter",
            "price": "$9",
            "interval": "month",
            "description": "Essential features for individuals and hobbyists looking to get started.",
            "features": [
              "1 User Seat",
              "Standard analytics suite",
              "5 GB Cloud Storage",
              "Email support (next business day response)"
            ],
            "cta_label": "Start Starter Trial",
            "cta_url": "https://example.com/signup/starter",
            "recommended": false
          },
          {
            "name": "Professional",
            "price": "$29",
            "interval": "month",
            "description": "Perfect for growing teams, creators, and power users who need more throughput.",
            "features": [
              "Up to 5 User Seats",
              "Advanced analytics with custom reports",
              "50 GB Cloud Storage",
              "Priority email & live chat support (2hr response)",
              "Full API access and standard webhooks"
            ],
            "cta_label": "Upgrade to Pro",
            "cta_url": "https://example.com/signup/pro",
            "recommended": true
          },
          {
            "name": "Enterprise",
            "price": "$99",
            "interval": "month",
            "description": "Bespoke controls, massive storage scale, and dedicated support for organizations.",
            "features": [
              "Unlimited User Seats",
              "Real-time analytics engine & database export",
              "500 GB Cloud Storage",
              "Dedicated account manager & 24/7 phone support",
              "SAML Single Sign-On (SSO)",
              "99.9% Uptime SLA guarantee"
            ],
            "cta_label": "Contact Sales",
            "cta_url": "https://example.com/contact/enterprise",
            "recommended": false
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
</a2ui-json>
